items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: We had Iggy Shaveck(?) and Hampton Hawes, and Roy Porter played the drums and I played the tenor.

ctx.x: We had Iggy Shaveck(?) and Hampton Hawes, and Roy Porter played the drums and I played the tenor. This was during the recording ban.. [LAUGHS] Yeah, but he paid us in cash money, so we went on and made that money [CHUCKLES] I think he wanted to kind of keep this over me, because I had this other good case against him, you know. He knew I had a very good case. But I hadn't gone to court at that time, you know.
